metaTitle: Custom Multi Color Pennants | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom multi color pennants in bulk for your next event. Perfect for schools, teams, and promotions. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom multi color pennants let you match your team or brand colors exactly, making them a standout choice for sporting events, school spirit promotions, and grand openings. Unlike single-color designs, these pennants combine two or more hues on felt or polyester, allowing for vibrant logos and text through screen printing or heat transfer. Choose from standard triangular shapes or custom sizes to fit your giveaway or retail display needs.
